title: Application of polypeptide in preparing medicine for treating type 2 immune disease
abstract: The invention discloses the use of a polypeptide comprising an amino acid sequence as shown in SEQ ID No.3, or a fragment, variant, fusion or derivative thereof, or a fusion of said fragment, variant or derivative thereof, in the manufacture of a medicament for the treatment of type 2 immune disorders. The invention provides a new method for preventing or treating type 2 immune diseases, and has potential clinical application value. The invention also discloses a method for detecting the Charcot-Laiden crystal.

title: Pharmaceutical composition comprising anti-tigit antibody and anti-pd-1/anti-vegfa bispecific antibody, and use thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of pharmaceuticals, particularly to an anti-TIGIT antibody, a pharmaceutical composition, and use thereof, and more particularly to use in combination with an anti-PD-1/anti-VEGFA antibody in preventing or treating a tumor. Specifically, the present invention relates to an anti-TIGIT antibody or an antigen-binding fragment thereof, wherein the antibody comprises a heavy chain variable region comprising HCDR1-HCDR3 having amino acid sequences set forth in SEQ ID NOs: 3-5, respectively; and the antibody comprises a light chain variable region comprising LCDR1-LCDR3 having amino acid sequences set forth in SEQ ID NOs: 8-10, respectively. The antibody of the present invention can effectively bind to TIGIT and has the potential for use in tumor prevention and treatment.

title: Human antibodies to Tn antigen
abstract: The present invention provides compositions for the production of an antibody or functional fragment thereof directed against Tn antigen or sTn antigen. The compositions disclosed herein include isolated antibody or functional fragments thereof that binds to Tn antigen or sTn antigen and polynucleotides encoding the heavy chain and/or a light chain variable domains of such antibody or functional fragment. The invention also provides methods of treating or preventing a disease, such as cancer or tumor formation, wherein the antibody or functional fragment includes a variable heavy chain domain and a variable light chain domain that has an amino acid sequence provided herein. The invention further provides a conjugate of an antibody or functional fragment thereof conjugated or recombinantly fused to a localizing agent, detectable agent or therapeutic agent, and methods of treating, preventing or diagnosing a disease in a subject in need thereof.

title: Modular targeted therapeutic agents and methods of making same
abstract: Provided herein are methods for making targeted therapeutics. In several embodiments, the therapeutics are directed against soluble agents such as toxins, venoms, and/or other factors that alter physiological biopathways as well as methods of using such therapeutics to treat patients or patient populations to reduce, eliminate, or inactivate, detrimental soluble agents that such patients or patient populations have been exposed to. In several embodiments, the therapeutics are directed to patient-specific disease markers. In several embodiments, the methods comprise screening a library comprising proteins linked to their cognate mRNAs to identify mRNA-protein pairs that bind to the diseased cells, isolating one or more proteins from the identified mRNA-protein pairs, and conjugating the isolated protein(s) to a therapeutic agent.

title: Immunoconjugates of an Anti-PD-1 antibody with a mutant IL-2 or with IL-15
abstract: The present invention generally relates to immunoconjugates, particularly immunoconjugates comprising a mutant interleukin-2 polypeptide and an antibody that binds to PD-1. In addition, the invention relates to polynucleotide molecules encoding the immunoconjugates, and vectors and host cells comprising such polynucleotide molecules. The invention further relates to methods for producing the mutant immunoconjugates, pharmaceutical compositions comprising the same, and uses thereof.

title: Nanometer material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a nano material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, connecting a graphite molded body and a conductive object which are respectively connected with a positive electrode and a negative electrode of a direct current power supply, placing the graphite molded body and the conductive object in electrolyte containing organic alkali, electrolyzing for 1-10 days under the voltage of 25-50V to obtain a first mixture containing carbon points and the organic alkali, S2, mixing a silicon source and an active center source, carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the obtained mixture and the first mixture to obtain a second mixture, S3, cooling the obtained reaction product, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a solid-phase product and a liquid-phase product, roasting the solid-phase product to obtain the nano material, and S4, enabling the liquid-phase product to be in contact with a porous material, wherein the pore size of the porous material is larger than that of the nano material. The nano material prepared by the method not only has better catalytic reaction activity, but also can directly discharge the wastewater generated in the preparation process.

title: Nanometer material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method of preparing a nanomaterial and nanomaterial prepared by the method, the method comprising: a. preparing a carbon dot solution; b. uniformly mixing a silicon source, an active center source, organic alkali and optional water to obtain a first mixture; c. mixing the carbon dot solution with the first mixture to perform hydrolysis reaction to obtain a second mixture; d. and carrying out hydrothermal treatment on the second mixture, collecting a solid product, washing, drying and roasting to obtain the nano material. The nano material disclosed by the invention has excellent catalytic activity in the phenol oxidation reaction, and meanwhile, the catalytic stability and repeatability are good.

title: Na 2 Fe(SO 4 ) 2 Preparation method of/C as composite positive electrode material of sodium-ion battery
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of sodium ion battery preparation, and particularly relates to Na 2 Fe(SO 4 ) 2 A preparation method of the composite positive electrode material of the sodium-ion battery; dispersing nano graphite in deionized water to obtain a mixed suspension; mixing sodium sulfate pentahydrate, ferrous sulfate heptahydrate and ascorbic acid according to a certain proportion, and spray-drying the nano graphite and Na 2 Fe(SO 4 ) 2 ·2H 2 O is tightly combined, the electrochemical performance of the material is greatly improved, the composite material is well coated by using a spray drying method, the conductivity of the material is improved, a precursor is synthesized by using a one-step method, the nano graphite and the precursor are mixed and spray dried, a three-dimensional spherical structure with uniform size is formed after spray drying, and the used medicine has the advantages of rich raw materials, low price and simple synthesis method.

title: Carbon-coated Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 Material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a carbon-coated Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 Material and preparation method thereof, and carbon-coated Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 The preparation method of the material comprises a dissolving step, and Fe (NO 3 ) 3 ·9H 2 0 is dissolved in deionized water, and citric acid is added to be fully stirredAfter that, naH is added 2 PO 4 Wherein Fe (NO) 3 ) 3 ·9H 2 0、NaH 2 PO 4 The ratio of the amount of the substances to the citric acid is (2.85-3.15): (3.9-4.3): (1.5-3.5); a drying step, namely drying the mixed solution obtained in the dissolving step to obtain a dried powder precursor; a heat treatment step, wherein the powder precursor is subjected to low-temperature solid phase reaction at 250-350 ℃ in inert atmosphere, and then subjected to high-temperature solid phase reaction at 450-700 ℃ to obtain the carbon-coated Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 A material. The preparation method can avoid synthesizing material Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 Contains Na 2 FeP 2 O 7 And NaFePO 4 And the impurity phases are equal, the phase purity is high, and the battery anode material has good electrochemical performance.

title: Electrode active material precursor and preparation method therefor, electrode active material and battery
abstract: Provided are an electrode active material precursor, a method for preparing the same, an electrode active material, and a battery. The electrode active material precursor includes carbon-composite oxide particles. The oxide satisfies a formula (1): M a O b (1), where element M is selected from one or more of transition metal elements having a relative atomic mass smaller than 65, and optionally being selected from one or more of Ni, Co, Fe, Mn, Zn, Mg, Ca, Cu, Mn, Sn, Mo, Ru, Ir, V, Nb, or Cr, a>0, and b>0. The carbon-composite oxide particles have a powder resistivity smaller than 100 Ω·cm.

title: Device is used in elevator accessory production and processing
abstract: The utility model discloses a device is used in elevator accessory production and processing, which comprises a platform, the bottom fixed mounting of platform has four landing legs that are two bisymmetry settings, the top central point of platform puts and has seted up the mounting hole, rotate through the bearing in the mounting hole and install the pivot, the both ends of pivot all extend to outside the mounting hole, there is first motor bottom the platform through support fixed mounting, the bottom of pivot and the output shaft end fixed connection of first motor, the top fixed mounting of pivot has the backup pad, the top fixed mounting of backup pad has electric putter, electric putter's output shaft end fixed mounting has the connecting seat. The utility model relates to a rationally, the practicality is good, can carry out spraying anti-rust paint to the surface of elevator accessory automatically to can heat to dry automatically the elevator accessory surface of spraying good paint, accelerate the solidification of anti-rust paint, not only reduce staff's the amount of labour, still improve work efficiency.

title: Device for storing and transporting crankshafts
abstract: The utility model discloses a device for storing and transporting crankshafts, which comprises a transporting box, wherein a supporting plate is arranged on the lower inner wall of the transporting box, a clamping plate is fixedly connected to the top end of the supporting plate, a buffering cushion is also arranged on the top end of the supporting plate, the clamping plate penetrates through the buffering cushion, the buffering cushion covers the side wall of the transporting box and the upper wall of the supporting plate, a rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the upper end of the side wall of the transporting box, a cover plate is fixedly sleeved on the rotating shaft, a handle is fixedly connected to the top end of the cover plate, and a fixing device is arranged in the transporting box. The utility model has simple structure and convenient operation, can fix the crankshafts in the transportation box, can not collide with each other during transportation, can not deform the crankshafts due to transportation, prolongs the service life of the crankshafts, can directly see the number of the crankshafts in the transportation box through the carving patterns on the transparent shell, and is more intuitive.

title: Rotating shaft mechanism and electronic device
abstract: The present application provides a rotating shaft mechanism and an electronic device. According to the rotating shaft mechanism, a support member is arranged in at least one of a main shaft and connecting plate assemblies; the support member comprises a support body and a protective portion; the protective portion is arranged on the surface of the side of the support body facing a flexible circuit board; the protective portion at least covers a contact portion of the support member, and the surface of the side of the protective portion facing the flexible circuit board is an insulating wear-resistant surface.

title: Roof placing executing device for material collecting and discharging shaft
abstract: The utility model discloses a top placing executing device of a material collecting and releasing shaft, which comprises supporting frames on two sides and an air expanding shaft axially fixed between the supporting frames, wherein a transmission mechanism is arranged on the supporting frame on one side to drive the air expanding shaft to rotate, a top clamping mechanism is arranged on one side of the air expanding shaft, a deviation adjusting mechanism is arranged on the other side of the air expanding shaft, conical parts are arranged at two ends of the air expanding shaft, an external gear is arranged at one end, close to the top clamping mechanism, of the air expanding shaft, the top clamping mechanism comprises a first conical top part and an internal gear, the first conical top part is attached to the conical parts, the internal gear is arranged at the periphery of the first conical top part, and when the first conical top part is attached to the conical parts, the external gear is meshed with the internal gear.

title: Detachable protection mechanism for block terminal
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of distribution boxes, and discloses a detachable protection mechanism for a distribution box, which comprises a box body, wherein a motor is connected inside the box body, one end of the motor is connected with a gear, a slide seat is connected above the box body, a second protection plate is connected on the inner side of one group of slide seats, a slide block connected on the inner side of each slide seat is arranged inside each second protection plate, a rack is connected below each second protection plate, the rack is connected with the gear, one side of the rack is connected with a first limiting block, the utility model starts the motor through the slide blocks, the slide seats, the motor, the gears and the racks to drive the gears to rotate, the racks and the second protection plates above the racks are driven to move under the connecting action of the gears and the racks, so that the slide block below the second protection plate slides out of the slide seats, and the second protection plates are separated from the box body, realize dismantling, solved and fixed in the block terminal top, do not possess the problem that can dismantle the function.

title: Method, apparatus and medium for data processing
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods, apparatuses, and media for data processing. According to various embodiments, a textual record is received that includes information related to a subject or object. At least one text sequence associated with at least one of a plurality of fields in the form is identified from the text record, the plurality of fields indicating a plurality of features of interest. Based on the result of the identification, a value of a respective field of the plurality of fields is determined. By this approach, information of the subject or object can be recorded using a structured form, making the information of the subject or object easier to view, store and access.

title: Image-forming apparatus, non-transitory computer-readable medium storing computer-readable instructions, and method for discharging deposits on a filter of an image-forming apparatus
abstract: The disclosure provides an image-forming apparatus which can remove deposits on the filter. If there is input via operation buttons indicating that ink supply paths are closed off, a CPU drives a pump while a nozzle cleaning valve and an exhaust waste fluid valve are open, and an atmospheric valve and a nozzle waste fluid valve are closed. The pressure in an exhaust waste fluid flow path and inside an exhaust cap becomes negative, such that cleaning fluid flows from a cleaning fluid bottle into a cleaning fluid flow path, a nozzle cleaning valve, a cleaning fluid flow path, a nozzle cap, a filter, an ink supply flow path, and an exhaust flow path. Therefore, deposits adhered to the filter from the ink passing through the filter separate from the filter due to the cleaning fluid passing through the filter, and these deposits flow into the exhaust flow path.

title: Chemical treatment, deposition and/or infiltration apparatus and methods of use thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a chemical deposition, treatment and/or infiltration apparatus for providing a chemical reaction on and/or in a surface of a substrate. The apparatus may have: a top reaction chamber portion and a bottom reaction chamber portion together forming a closable reaction chamber; and an actuator constructed and arranged for moving the top reaction chamber portion and the bottom reaction chamber portion relative to each other from a closed position to an open position so as to allow access to the interior of the reaction chamber. A top substrate holder is connected to the top reaction chamber portion to hold a substrate at least when the reaction chamber is in an open position, and a bottom substrate holder is connected to the bottom reaction chamber portion to hold the substrate when the reaction chamber is in a closed position.

title: Methods and apparatus for processing a substrate
abstract: Methods and apparatus for processing a substrate are provided herein. For example, a gas supply configured for use with a processing chamber includes an ampoule that stores a precursor and comprises an input to receive a carrier gas and an output to provide a mixture of the carrier gas and the precursor to the processing chamber and a sensor assembly comprising a detector and an infrared source operably connected to an outside of an enclosure, through which the mixture flows, and a gas measurement volume disposed within the enclosure and along an inner wall thereof so that a concentration of the precursor in the mixture can be measured by the detector and transmitted to a controller.

title: Information processing device and information processing program
abstract: To obtain an information processing device and an information processing program that can improve ease of communication in a target space.SOLUTION: An information processing device 10 includes: an acquisition unit 11A that acquires audio information indicating a voice uttered by a person present in a target space in which a predetermined background sound is played; an estimation unit 11B that, in parallel with the acquisition of the audio information by the acquisition unit 11A, estimates, from the audio information, at least one of a type-specific emotion value indicating intensity of multiple predetermined types of emotions by the person and an overall emotion value indicating overall intensity of the emotion by the person; a derivation unit 11C that derives selection information for selecting a filter that guides the person present in the target space into a target psychological state by causing at least one of the type-specific emotion value and the overall emotion value to act on the background sound; and an execution unit 11D that performs filtering on the background sound using a filter corresponding to the selection information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Display comprising a light-guiding optical element with two-dimensional expansion
abstract: A display (10) includes a planar light guide optical element (LOE) (100) having first and second progressive deflector devices associated with first and second regions (110, 120) thereof. A support device (106), such as an eyeglass frame, supports the LOE in facing relationship with the user's eyes. An image projector (200) injects a collimated image into the LOE via a reflective incoupling surface (131). The reflective incoupling surface is preferably oriented obliquely with respect to the main horizontal and vertical axes of the LOE. The multipart wedge (132) is preferably used to compensate for chromatic aberration.

title: Display device
abstract: A display device, comprising: a base substrate (100); a plurality of sub-pixels (200) on a substrate (100); and a light splitting structure (300) configured to direct image light emitted by the plurality of sub-pixels (200) to different viewpoint regions, the light splitting structure (300) including a plurality of light splitting sections (310) arranged in a row direction and extending in a column direction. Each sub-pixel (200) comprises a plurality of display units (202) arranged along a row direction, a plurality of sub-pixels (200) are arranged into a plurality of sub-pixel row groups (2000), the plurality of sub-pixel row groups (2000) extend along the row direction and are arranged along a column direction, each sub-pixel row group (2000) comprises at least two rows of sub-pixels (200), a space (201) is arranged between two adjacent sub-pixels (200) in each row of sub-pixels (200), and the sub-pixels (200) in two adjacent rows in each sub-pixel row group (2000) are staggered with each other in the row direction to enable the spaces (201) between the sub-pixels (200) in one row of sub-pixels (200) and the sub-pixels (200) in the other row of sub-pixels (200) to be overlapped in the column direction; the ratio of the size of each light splitting part (310) along the row direction to the pitch of the sub-pixels (200) is 0.9 to 1.1, and the brightness compensation at the intervals of the sub-pixels (200) which emit light discontinuously can be realized to eliminate moire fringes.

title: Electronic device
abstract: An electronic device includes a light guide plate, a plurality of light sources, a plastic frame and at least an optical film. The light guide plate includes a first terminal and a second terminal opposite to the first terminal. The plurality of light sources are disposed adjacent to the second terminal and are arranged along the first direction. The plastic frame is disposed adjacent to the first terminal. One of the at least an optical film includes a body part and a protrude part connected to the body part, and the protrude part is fixed on the plastic frame, the body part includes a first side adjacent to the plastic frame, and in a second direction, a shortest distance between the first side and the plastic film is in a range between 0 to 0.4 mm.

title: Display device and optical unit
abstract: To reduce distortion to improve resolution.SOLUTION: A display device 100 comprises: a projector lens 21 that transmits image light ML from a video element 11; a prism mirror 22 that makes the image light ML emitted from the projector lens 21 incident on a light incident surface 22a, reflects the image light on an internal reflection surface 22b, and emits the image light from a light emission surface 22c; and a see-through mirror 23 that reflects the image light ML emitted from the prism mirror 22 toward a pupil position. The prism mirror 22 and the see-through mirror 23 are arranged to bend a light path along a reference surface to form an off-axis optical system. An intermediate image IM is formed between the internal reflection surface 22b and the see-through mirror 23. The display device includes, between the internal reflection surface 22b and the see-through mirror 23 with respect to the reference surface, the light emission surface 22c as a refractive surface having a front side area R1 with a relatively high refractive power on a front side and an area R2 with a relatively low refractive power on a rear side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Display panel and display device
abstract: The invention discloses a display panel and a display device, wherein the display panel comprises an optical component area and a conventional display area; the substrate comprises a plurality of pixels, each pixel comprises a light-emitting device and a pixel driving circuit which are electrically connected; the light emitting device includes a first light emitting device and a second light emitting device; the conventional display area is provided with a first light-emitting device; the optical component area is provided with a second light emitting device; the optical component region includes a first optical component region and a second optical component region; the first optical member region includes a first light-transmitting region and a plurality of first light-shielding regions; the first light-shielding region covers at least one second light-emitting device; the second optical component area comprises a second light-transmitting area and a plurality of second light-shielding areas; the second light-shielding region covers at least one second light-emitting device; the first light-shielding area and the second light-shielding area have no parallel edges. The technical scheme provided by the invention can enhance the imaging effect of the photosensitive element area of the display panel.

title: Intelligent analysis system and method for communication data
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent analysis system and method for communication data, which relate to the technical field of data transmission, wherein the system comprises the steps of acquiring an intelligent household equipment list; the method comprises the steps of obtaining target household scene information interactively, carrying out equipment application analysis on the target household scene information to obtain a target application household equipment set, constructing a communication analysis cloud, carrying out matching mapping and resource analysis on a household equipment control model group to obtain a target equipment control model set, and carrying out communication control on the target application household equipment set based on a household equipment control parameter set. Solves the technical problems that the prior household equipment communication data analysis has insufficient data island and equipment compatibility, so that the user needs are difficult to be matched accurately, and the analysis processing of the communication data is not accurate, comprehensive and intelligent, the intelligent household device has the advantages that the comprehensive capture, intelligent analysis and accurate control of communication data among intelligent household devices are realized, and the technical effects of improving the analysis accuracy and the intellectualization of the communication data are achieved.

title: Artificial intelligence based monitoring system and monitoring method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring, and provides a monitoring system and a monitoring method based on artificial intelligence, wherein the monitoring system comprises a data acquisition unit; a data storage unit; the data processing unit is used for analyzing and processing the data through an artificial intelligence technology, acquiring image data, monitoring equipment data and shooting time data which are identified from a video, inputting multi-source information data into a machine learning model, and acquiring image data classified according to image types and/or image data classified according to monitoring equipment and/or image data ordered according to time sequence; the data matching unit is used for comparing the target image data with the label data obtained by the data processing unit, if the comparison is consistent, the matching is successful, and if the comparison is inconsistent, the matching is failed; and the data positioning unit is used for positioning all image data successfully matched in the data matching unit to acquire video data. The invention can save the time for the user to know the monitoring condition of the target area.

title: Ai discernment long-range real-time supervision device
abstract: The utility model provides an Ai discernment long-range real-time supervision device relates to monitoring facilities technical field, including the work casing, the position fixedly connected with camera is close to the top on work casing front surface, the position fixedly connected with control switch is close to the middle part on work casing front surface, the work casing lower surface has seted up the interface that charges, the work casing upper surface has seted up the data interface, the work casing rear surface symmetry is provided with the connecting plate; the utility model discloses a control switch is opened to top center fixedly connected with receiving module in the work casing, monitors the work through the camera to monitoring range, and the data transfer that the camera was gathered gives processing module, and processing module compares data transfer for work module, and data through work module position and storage module confirms that safety then continues to monitor the work, if dangerous, then uploads alarm signal through signal transmission module to promote terminal staff and notice the tour.

title: Ai system based on edge-computing for reinforcing safe-management in industrial site
abstract: The present invention relates to an edge computing-based artificial intelligence (AI) system for reinforcing safety management in industrial sites, which accurately recognizes accidents. According to the present invention, the edge computing-based AI system comprises: an image input unit to which an on-site image is input from a camera module; a characteristic information storage unit storing characteristic information including identification information or location information for the camera module; an object recognition unit recognizing one or more target objects included in the on-site image by using raw data on the basis of AI processing; a main processing unit transmitting, to a control server, request information including information on a first event and the characteristic information when the first event recognizing a target object occurs by the object recognition unit; a feedback information receiving unit receiving feedback information in response to the request information from the control server when the first event is not a scheduled task or the information of the location where the target object is recognized is not scheduled location information; and an alarm processing unit outputting a danger signal by operating an alarm means when the feedback information is received.

title: High-precision network detection system
abstract: The utility model provides a high-precision network detection system, wherein a monitoring camera is used for monitoring the environment in a ship cabin in real time, information between the monitoring camera and a storage module can be interconnected through the arrangement of an exchanger, monitored pictures can be automatically stored in the storage module, a display terminal can check the monitored pictures in real time, a historical picture in the storage module is called, a biological sign recognition device is used for intelligently recognizing personnel in the ship, the characteristics and the position information of the personnel are recognized, later rescue is facilitated, broadcasting equipment can realize broadcasting and shouting of all areas or a certain area, emergency broadcasting information can be timely played under emergency conditions, the playing of music functions is stopped, and the personnel are rapidly guided to be evacuated until the emergency state is relieved. The fire detector can transmit information such as smoke, temperature and the like to the alarm controller, and the alarm controller automatically starts an evacuation mark to guide people to evacuate, so that the safety of people and property is protected.

title: Natural excipient and method for making same
abstract: The present invention relates to a natural excipient composition capable of contributing to the promotion of public health by not adding chemical excipients such as silicon dioxide, magnesium stearate, and the like, which are commonly used in the manufacture of pharmaceuticals or functional foods, and a method for manufacturing the same. By adding seaweed powder, korean wheat, sweet potato starch, corn starch, and whole wheat powder, which are vegetable raw materials, it is an excellent invention that can contribute to a safe and safe and safe pharmaceutical composition or health functional food industry.

title: Composition with antioxidant and whitening effects and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of food processing, and particularly provides a composition with an antioxidant and whitening effect, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composition with the antioxidant and whitening effect at least comprises, by weight, 20-40 parts of glutathione-enriched yeast extract, 0.5-5 parts of burdock root extract, 0.5-5 parts of cordyceps militaris extract, 0.2-2 parts of tricholoma matsutake freeze-dried powder, 0.2-2 parts of boletus concentrated powder and 20-40 parts of osmanthus fragrans powder. The composition provided by the technical scheme is compounded according to a certain proportion, so that the composition has good antioxidation and whitening effects.

title: Preparation method of Chinese herbal medicine fermentation primary pulp with anti-allergic effect
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of Chinese herbal medicine fermentation primary pulp with anti-allergic effect, which specifically comprises the following steps: step S101, activating strains: carrying out bifidobacterium strain and lactobacillus strain activation through line drawing and fungus shaking to obtain activated strains; step S102, preparing medicinal materials: pulverizing and sieving the composite materials of cortex Dictamni Radicis, flos Matricariae Chamomillae, radix et caulis Opuntiae Dillenii and Glycyrrhrizae radix to obtain semi-finished product; the invention is based on fermentation technology: the microorganism is subjected to large-scale growth culture to generate chemical change and physiological change, so that a large amount of metabolic products required by human fermentation are generated and accumulated, and bifidobacteria and lactobacillus are utilized to perform composite fermentation on cortex dictamni, chamomile, cactus and liquorice, so that a fermentation liquid which is anti-allergic, safe, mild and good in skin affinity is produced, and the fermentation liquid is suitable for adding of cosmetic raw materials.

title: Combined use of a plant based drink with improved phytase and PAD
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of food. The present invention provides a method for obtaining improved properties of a beverage comprising plant protein, the method comprising incubating a solution comprising plant protein with a phytase and a Peptidyl Arginine Deiminase (PAD), and optionally processing the phytase and PAD treated solution into a beverage comprising plant protein, wherein the plant protein is pea protein or broad bean protein.

title: Device and method for forming a product that imitates properties of meat, poultry, fish, seafood, dairy products, or products derived therefrom
abstract: The present invention is related to a method for the manufacture of a product that imitates properties of meat, poultry, fish, seafood, dairy products such as cheese or yoghurt, or products derived therefrom, comprising the step of dosing and depositing a first and optionally a second material onto a surface, preferably in a cavity ( 19 ), of a product carrier ( 16 ), preferably a mold, wherein at least one said first material and second material comprises a protein, preferably a vegetable protein, insect protein, cell protein including single cell protein, such as of yeast, bacteria, microalgae, fungi, fermented products, mold and the like, or a mixture of different proteins, wherein the protein content in the dry raw materials is 35 to 90%, preferably greater than 50% and is particularly preferably in the range from 60% to 90%.

title: Electrical structure and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a substrate; a first insulation layer disposed over a first surface of the substrate; a second insulation layer disposed on the first insulation layer; and an electrical contact extending through the first and second insulation layers to electrically connect to the first surface of the substrate. The electrical contact includes a first portion disposed in the first insulation layer and a second portion disposed in the second insulation layer, the first portion has a first width, the second portion has a second width, and a ratio of a difference between the first width and the second width to the first width is less than 10%; at least one isolation feature extending into the substrate and disposed below the first surface of the substrate; and at least one conductive feature extending through the second insulation layer and the first insulation layer and into the substrate.

title: Semiconductor structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A semiconductor structure includes a substrate, a bit line, and a first isolation layer. A groove is set in the substrate. A bottom end of the bit line is set in the groove. The first isolation layer is at least partially set on a sidewall of the bit line, and the first isolation layer is in direct contact with the bit line.

title: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract: The invention provides a semiconductor device and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the manufacturing method of the semiconductor device comprises the steps of providing a substrate; forming a substrate, forming a buffer layer on the substrate, forming a hard mask layer on the buffer layer, forming an opening penetrating through the hard mask layer and the buffer layer, etching back the buffer layer on the side wall of the opening so that the buffer layer on the side wall of the opening is retracted relative to the hard mask layer and the substrate to form an air gap, forming a blocking layer to seal the air gap, and carrying out local thermal oxidation on the substrate on the inner wall of the opening to form a field oxide layer. According to the technical scheme, the bird's beak-shaped transverse extension part formed at the edge of the field oxide layer can be avoided, so that the reduction of the area of the active area surrounded by the field oxide layer is avoided.

title: Method of manufacturing a semiconductor device and structure and semiconductor structure
abstract: A method of manufacturing a semiconductor device includes: receiving a device substrate; forming an interconnect structure on the front side of the device substrate; and etching a recess into the back side of the device substrate until a portion of the interconnect structure is exposed. The recess has a recess depth, and an edge of the recess is defined by a sidewall of the device substrate. A conductive bond pad is formed in the recess, and the first plurality of layers covers the conductive bond pad, extends along the sidewall of the device substrate, and covers the backside of the device substrate. The first plurality of layers collectively have a first overall thickness that is less than the depth of the groove. A first chemical mechanical planarization is performed to remove portions of the first plurality of layers such that remaining portions of the first plurality of layers cover the conductive bond pads. Embodiments of the invention also relate to methods of manufacturing semiconductor structures and to semiconductor structures.

title: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A fabrication method includes: providing a substrate having a front side surface, a back side surface, and a contact pad region; providing an interconnect structure embedded in an interlayer dielectric (ILD) layer below the front side surface of the substrate; forming a first contact pad opening in the contact pad region that extends from above the back side surface through the substrate to an interior area of the ILD layer below the front side surface; forming a contact pad that extends from the first contact pad opening to the interconnect structure; forming an oxide layer over the contact pad; and forming a scribe line pad opening through the oxide layer to the contact pad.

title: Automatic detection system
abstract: The utility model provides an automatic detection system, which comprises a sample tube and an analyzer, wherein a connecting part is connected with the sample tube and a cover body suitable for sealing an opening at the upper end of the sample tube, and the cover body is provided with an extending part extending to the outer side of the sample tube; a plurality of sampling units; the bearing part is arranged on the lower side of the limiting part and bears the stacked sampling units; the mobile platform provides two-dimensional movement and rotation for the rotating arm; the tray comprises a plurality of bearing units distributed in an array manner; the tray moves horizontally in two dimensions under the driving of the tray, and the sampling unit on the movable platform is suitable for being positioned at the upper side of any through hole; the first moving piece is positioned at the lower side of the through hole and drives the sample tube in the through hole to move up and down; the clamping mechanism is used for clamping and loosening the upwards moved sample tube; the second moving piece arranged on the upper side of the clamping mechanism is provided with a fixing part suitable for fixing the extending part; the rotating mechanism drives the second moving member to rotate forward and backward. The utility model has the advantages of automation, small volume and the like.

title: Airtight detection equipment
abstract: The utility model provides an airtight detection equipment, include: the detection sleeve is provided with a detection space, the bottom of the detection space is provided with a fixed disk for placing a workpiece to be detected, an air inlet and an air outlet which are connected with an air source are formed in the side wall of the fixed disk, the outer side of the detection sleeve is provided with a driving mechanism for fixing the workpiece to be detected on the fixed disk, a first through hole communicated with the detection space is formed in the side wall of the detection sleeve and is connected with a water tank, and the water tank is connected with a water pressure control device for controlling water flow. The beneficial effects of the utility model reside in that: the water pressure control device is used for injecting water in the water tank into the detection space and submerging the workpiece to be detected, so that the problem that the air pressure inside the part is damaged when the workpiece to be detected is placed in the water in the prior art is solved; the workpiece to be detected is fixed on the fixed disc through the driving mechanism, so that the problem that the workpiece to be detected moves in the detection process is solved.

title: Laboratory sample analysis detection device
abstract: The utility model discloses a laboratory sample analysis and detection device, which belongs to the technical field of water quality detection and comprises a box body and a conveying pump arranged on one side of the box body, wherein a discharge pipe is arranged at the output end of the conveying pump, a feed pipe is arranged at the input end of the conveying pump, a cleaning device is arranged in the box body, a third electric telescopic rod is arranged on the box body, a detection head is arranged at the output end of the third electric telescopic rod, and a first electric telescopic rod is arranged on the box body. According to the utility model, the position of the cleaning block can be adjusted by arranging the second electric telescopic rod, the cleaning block can be moved to the lower part of the detection head when the detection head needs to be cleaned, the detection head can be moved to the inner part of the cleaning block by arranging the third electric telescopic rod, the detection head can be cleaned by the electric cleaning block when the second motor is started by arranging the second motor, the detection head does not need to be cleaned manually, and the cleaning efficiency is high.

title: Specimen detection device
abstract: The utility model relates to a sample detection device, including sampling subassembly and picture peg subassembly, still include detection subassembly and schizolysis liquid subassembly. The detection assembly is formed by nesting an inner bottle body and an outer bottle body, the plugboard assembly is arranged between the inner bottle body and the outer bottle body, the electrolyte dissolution assembly is arranged in a cavity of the inner bottle body, the electrolyte dissolution assembly comprises a electrolyte dissolution bottle and a sealing film covering the electrolyte dissolution bottle, an overflow hole is formed in the longitudinal direction of the inner bottle body from the bottom, and when the bottom of the electrolyte dissolution bottle contacts with the bottom of the inner bottle body, the height of the electrolyte dissolution assembly is higher than that of the electrolyte dissolution bottle. The device is designed integrally aiming at the sample with small sampling amount and needing to be mixed with the lysate for detection, so that the device is more convenient and fast in the mixing operation of the sample and the lysate, reduces operation pollution and improves accuracy.

title: Water quality testing equipment for hydraulic engineering
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of water quality detection devices, in particular to water quality detection equipment for hydraulic engineering, which comprises a working box and a sliding storage groove, wherein the inside of the working box is in a cavity shape, a box door is movably arranged on the front side surface of the working box, bottom feet are fixed at four vertex angles of the lower surface of the working box, and two groups of handles are symmetrically fixed on the two side surfaces of the working box. According to the utility model, the grab handle is held and the screw rod is screwed, the double-inclined-plane extrusion block can be pushed to slide inwards along the surface of the limiting guide rail under the meshing action with the threaded hole, then under the inclined-plane extrusion action, the two groups of inclined planes of the double-inclined-plane extrusion block push the expansion plates on the two sides, the expansion plates overcome the elasticity of the spring and extend out from the two ports of the sliding accommodating groove after being pressed, tools used for detection can be placed in the accommodating groove A, the accommodating groove B and the accommodating groove C on the surface of the expansion plate, and a good detection platform is further provided to facilitate the operation of water quality detection.

title: Curable composition, and cured product
abstract: Provided are: a curable composition containing a heat-conductive filler (A), including at least one selected from the group consisting of heat-conductive fillers A having a volume average particle size of 0.3 μm to less than 1 μm and heat-conductive fillers B having a volume average particle size of 1 μm to less than 10 μm, and a heat-conductive filler C having a volume average particle size of 10-15 μm (inclusive), a monomer (B) having a (meth)acryloyl group, a polymerization initiator (C), and a dispersant (D), based on the total mass of the heat-conductive filler (A), the content X of the heat-conductive filler A being 0-40 mass%, the content Y of the heat-conductive filler B being 0-40 mass%, and the content Z of the heat-conductive filler C being 20-60 mass% (where, content X and content Y are not both 0 mass%); and a cured product thereof.

title: Composition, preparation method thereof and carrier
abstract: The disclosure provides a composition, a preparation method thereof and a carrier, and belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials. The composition comprises, by mass, 50% -85% of cycloolefin resin, 3% -25% of a first thermoplastic elastomer, 10% -25% of a second thermoplastic elastomer and 0.3% -8% of a conductive filler. The first thermoplastic elastomer comprises a thermoplastic elastomer and a polar monomer grafted to the thermoplastic elastomer, wherein the polar monomer comprises at least one of maleic anhydride, itaconic anhydride, citraconic anhydride, crotonic anhydride, acrylic acid, methacrylic acid, methyl acrylate, ethyl acrylate, methyl methacrylate, ethyl methacrylate and glycidyl methacrylate. The second thermoplastic elastomer includes a styrene segment as a repeating unit. The material of the composition has the characteristics of low moisture absorption, high heat resistance, high cleanliness, high mechanical strength and antistatic property.

title: Resin composition, cured product, prepreg, metal foil-clad laminate, resin composite sheet, printed wiring board, and semiconductor device
abstract: The present invention provides a resin composition, a cured product, a prepreg, a metal foil-clad laminate, a resin composite sheet, a printed wiring board, and a semiconductor device. The resin composition contains an elastomer (A), a compound (B) represented by formula (GU), and a radical polymerization initiator (C). The elastomer (A) includes a polymer block (a1) containing a conjugated diene compound unit and a styrene compound unit having a radical reactive group. The content of the elastomer (A) is 1-30 parts by mass with respect to 100 parts by mass of the resin solid content. In formula (GU), R 1 and R 2 are hydrogen atoms or substituents, two R 2 are the same as each other, at least one of R 1 and R 2 is a group including a (meth)allyl group, and R 3 and R 4 each independently represent a hydrogen atom, an alkyl group, or an aryl group.

title: Coating material composition and in-mold coating method
abstract: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a coating material composition which has a low VOC content and which can form a coating film having excellent hardness, water resistance, weathering resistance and pinhole resistance. The present invention provides a coating material composition which contains: (A) a main agent containing a hydroxyl group-containing acrylic resin composition that includes (a1) a hydroxyl group-containing acrylic resin and (a2) a polyhydric alcohol; and (B) a curing agent containing a polyisocyanate compound. The hydroxyl group-containing acrylic resin (a1) is synthesized using a solution polymerization method. A solution used in the solution polymerization method contains the polyhydric alcohol (a2).

title: Chemically cured water-based 2-component compositions
abstract: The present invention relates to a two-component composition comprising: A) a first component a comprising: -an aqueous dispersion of at least one polymer P1; B) a second component B comprising: -at least one hydraulic binder H, -at least one functional compound P2; wherein both components a and B are liquid or pasty and both are prepared and stored separately and mixed directly before application; and with the proviso that the functional compound P2 comprises a functional group which chemically reacts with said aqueous dispersion of said first polymer P1 to form a crosslinked and/or chain-extended polymer. The compositions of the present invention are highly suitable cementitious adhesives, joint sealants, casting compositions or coatings and exhibit improved mechanical properties, adhesive properties and resistance and minimized plasticizer migration problems.

title: Portable electric power storage power generation facility of movable
abstract: A movable portable power storage and generation device relates to a vehicle-mounted power device and aims to solve the problem that energy is wasted due to the fact that charging and power utilization of an existing vehicle-mounted power supply device cannot be accurately controlled. The singlechip is connected with the touch display screen; the touch display screen is used for inputting a control instruction; the electric quantity monitor is used for monitoring the electric energy of the electric energy storage unit and is connected with the single chip microcomputer; the singlechip is connected with the current converter; the converter is connected with the converter transformer; meanwhile, the current converter is connected with the driving module; the driving signal output end of the driving module is connected with the driving signal input end of the generator; the high-voltage signal output end of the converter transformer is connected with the high-voltage signal input end of the high-voltage vacuum switch, and the converter transformer is used for controlling the voltage of the output current of the electric energy storage unit; the electric energy storage unit supplies power to the vehicle-mounted electric appliance through the high-voltage vacuum switch; the bottom of the power device body is provided with universal wheels. The beneficial effect is that the control is accurate with the electric voltage.

title: Power supply device for thermal processing
abstract: To provide a power supply device for thermal processing that can prevent an electric mobile object from being unable to move to a charging facility due to a decrease in the remaining amount of charge of a storage battery.SOLUTION: A welding power supply device A1 includes: a power conversion unit 1 that performs power conversion of DC power input from an electric vehicle 9 having a storage battery 91; a control unit 2 that controls the power conversion unit 1; and a communication unit 5 that communicates with the electric vehicle 9 and receives information on the remaining amount of charge of the storage battery 91. The control unit 2 includes: a threshold setting unit 24 that sets a threshold for comparison with the information on the remaining amount of charge received by the communication unit 5; and a comparison unit 25 that detects a low remaining amount state when the information on the remaining amount of charge becomes equal to or less than the threshold value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Power supply method and system for vehicle door, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The application provides a power supply method, a power supply system, electronic equipment and a storage medium of a vehicle door, which comprise the steps of controlling an energy collecting device to obtain electric energy and storing the obtained electric energy into the energy storing device; and when the voltage of the vehicle battery is smaller than the working voltage threshold value, controlling the energy storage device to transmit the stored electric energy to a preset device on the vehicle door so as to supply power to the preset device. By adopting the technical scheme provided by the application, the energy utilization efficiency and the vehicle safety are improved.

title: Power supply apparatus
abstract: The utility model discloses a power supply device. The power supply equipment comprises a storage battery interface, an MOS tube and a high-power absorbing device. The storage battery interface is used for connecting an energy storage component, and the energy storage component supplies power for an electric device of the vehicle through the storage battery interface. The MOS tube is used for connecting the energy storage component and the battery interface. The high-power absorption device is connected with the MOS tube in parallel and is used for enabling the voltage of the MOS tube to be smaller than a preset voltage. In the power supply equipment, the high-power absorbing device is arranged in parallel with the MOS tube, and the high-power absorbing device can clamp the voltage of the MOS tube, so that the voltage of the MOS tube is smaller than the preset voltage, and reverse spike voltage generated by closing the MOS tube is effectively prevented from breaking down the MOS tube.

title: Battery pack and electric automobile
abstract: The utility model discloses a battery pack and an electric automobile. The battery panel includes: the battery comprises a plurality of battery cells, a flexible composite row, a battery energy distribution module, a control module and an external interface. The flexible composite row is connected with the battery core; the battery energy distribution module is connected with the flexible composite row; the control module is connected with the battery energy distribution module; the control module is used for controlling the on-off of the battery energy distribution module; the external interface is connected with the control module; the external interface is used for being connected with an external circuit; the circuit of the battery energy distribution module connected with the external interface is configured as a high-voltage circuit; the loop of the control module connected with the external interface is configured as a low-voltage loop; the low-pressure circuit and the high-pressure circuit are provided separately. The embodiment of the utility model is beneficial to enhancing the shock resistance and the control reliability of the battery pack.

title: Method for additive manufacturing of a part
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for additive manufacturing of a part, comprising the following successive steps: forming a layer of powder on a construction support; using a high-energy device to perform a melting step in which the layer of powder thus formed is illuminated by means of at least one beam and the at least one beam is moved in order to form a temperature profile at each point of the layer, said profile including successively: a first, positive thermal gradient G1 for gradually preheating the powder, a melting peak for melting the powder, and a second, negative thermal gradient G2 for gradually cooling the powder.

title: Heat dissipation structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The application provides a heat dissipation structure, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method of the heat dissipation structure comprises the steps of obtaining a melt for forming a first part, casting a second part and the melt, wherein the second part is not melted, and the heat conductivity of the second part is larger than that of the first part. According to the preparation method of the heat radiation structure, the second part with high heat conductivity is directly inlaid on the first part in the casting process of the first part with low heat conductivity in a casting compound mode, so that the interface bonding rate of the first part and the second part is improved, the formation of a tin welding layer, nickel plating treatment and the like are avoided, the interface thermal resistance is finally reduced, the heat radiation efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the preparation method has the advantages of high yield, high production efficiency, low cost, environmental friendliness and the like.

title: Die casting method for die casting aluminum-silicon alloy and refining pre-crystallized structure
abstract: A die casting method for die casting aluminum-silicon alloy and refining pre-crystallized structure relates to the technical field of aluminum-silicon alloy materials, solves the problem of poor mechanical property of die casting aluminum-silicon alloy, and can be applied to manufacturing of automobiles, high-speed trains and large aircrafts. The alloy comprises 8 to 11wt% silicon, 0.3 to 0.8wt% iron, 0.2 to 0.6wt% manganese, 0.1 to 0.5wt% molybdenum, 0.1 to 0.5wt% vanadium, 0.1 to 0.5wt% zirconium, 0.01 to 0.5wt% niobium, 0.1 to 0.5wt% titanium, 0.01 to 0.3wt% boron, 0.01 to 0.2wt% nickel, 0.02 to 0.1wt% strontium, not more than 0.1wt% impurities, and the balance aluminum. Placing the alloy ingot into a heat preservation furnace for melting, preserving heat, introducing argon and stirring; carrying out slag skimming treatment on the aluminum liquid to remove surface scum; and standing the aluminum liquid, reducing the temperature to a specific temperature, performing high-pressure die casting, and vacuumizing by a vacuum machine.

title: Smelting process of sulfur-containing stainless steel continuous casting blank for granular material ring die
abstract: The invention relates to a smelting process of a sulfur-containing stainless steel continuous casting blank for a granular material ring die, wherein an alkaline electric furnace burden comprises three or more stages of scrap steel and pig iron, a carburant and lime are added into a furnace before charging, an induction furnace is switched to an alloy molten steel station after steel tapping of a steel ladle, the induction furnace burden comprises medium-carbon ferromanganese and medium-carbon ferrochrome, the alloy molten steel is discharged into the same steel ladle after proper temperature, refining is carried out outside a converter after steel receiving, vacuum degassing is carried out after proper temperature, the temperature is measured after the steel ladle of the VD station is in place, the sufficient time is kept under the condition of less than or equal to 0.7mbar, on-line hydrogen determination is carried out after breaking, a sulfur supplementing line is carried out, the temperature is proper after the steel ladle is subjected to continuous casting station pouring after weak stirring before hanging, an argon blowing plug rod and an integral invasive water gap are selected as a tundish in the continuous casting station, argon gas is filled into the tundish after baking and stopping baking, a non-carbon covering agent and a carbonized rice hull are selected as a middle covering cover, the steel billet is annealed for standby, the material utilization rate is improved by more than 5 percent on the premise of not affecting service life.

title: Hardware continuous casting equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses hardware continuous casting equipment which comprises a bottom plate, a balancing weight, a driving assembly and a driving assembly, wherein the bottom of the balancing weight is fixedly connected with the top of the bottom plate, the driving assembly comprises a U-shaped frame, a rotating column, a driven gear, a driving gear and a motor, the bottom of the U-shaped frame is fixedly connected with the top of the balancing weight, the outer surface of the rotating column is rotationally connected with the inside of the U-shaped frame, one end of the rotating column is fixedly connected with the inside of the driven gear, the driven gear is meshed with the driving gear, and the inside of the driving gear is fixedly connected with a driving shaft of the motor. According to the scheme, the bottom plate, the balancing weight, the driving assembly, the melting furnace, the sensing assembly, the crystallizer, the cooling water tank and the liquid guide tank are arranged, through the structure, the melting furnace can be timely controlled to stop falling when molten metal is about to be filled, the effect of preventing the molten metal from overflowing and scalding workers is achieved, and the filtering assembly is arranged, through the structure, refractory matters in the molten metal are screened out, and the effect of enabling the quality of cast products to be higher is achieved.

title: Manual formula elevating gear for new material processing production
abstract: The invention discloses a lifting device for manual new material processing production, which adopts the technical scheme that: the cutting device comprises a lifting device, a cutting device and a cutting table, wherein the lifting device is fixedly installed on the inner wall of one end of the cutting table, the cutting table is close to a fixed installation support at the top of one end of the lifting device, the support is close to a fixed installation chute at one end of the lifting device, the lifting device is fixedly installed at one end of the chute, the cutting device is fixedly installed at the bottom of one end, away from the chute, of the lifting device, the lifting device comprises a bearing, the bearing is fixedly installed on the inner wall of one end of the cutting table, a threaded rod is connected to the inner wall of the bearing, an internal thread cylinder is fixedly installed on the outer wall of one end of the threaded rod, a: the novel material cutting device is favorable for realizing free up-and-down movement of the cutting device, so that the novel material cutting effect is good, and convenience is provided for subsequent processing of the novel material.

title: Grooving device for processing color steel plates
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of milling engineering and discloses a slotting device for processing color steel plates, which comprises a processing platform and a cutting machine, wherein a triaxial gantry truss is arranged on the upper side of the processing platform, the cutting machine is arranged on the upper side of the processing platform through the triaxial gantry truss, a telescopic rod is slidably arranged on the side surface of the processing platform, one end of the telescopic rod can be slidably inserted into the processing platform, a first telescopic cylinder for driving a first positioning plate to move left and right is arranged on the lower side of the processing platform, and a second positioning plate is slidably arranged on one side of the processing platform. According to the scheme, the size of the processing platform is reduced, the first positioning plate is used as a processing auxiliary platform, the first positioning plate and the second positioning plate are used for propping the two ends of the material to be processed tightly, the positioning function is achieved, the first positioning plate stretches out and draws back the material to be processed to one side, the two ends of the material to be processed can be grooved and processed on the upper side of the processing platform, the auxiliary pushing and positioning effects are achieved, and the processing auxiliary platform is more labor-saving and convenient to use.

title: Loading attachment of cutting piece production and processing
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mechanical cutting, in particular to a feeding device for production and processing of a cutting sheet, which comprises two fixing plates; the fixed plate is provided with a first motor, the output end of the first motor is connected with one of the conveying rollers, a plurality of cutting sheet dies are fixedly connected on the conveying belt, the cutting sheet dies are equidistantly arranged, one fixed plate is welded with a fixed frame, the fixed frame is provided with a graduated scale, the end part of the fixed frame is fixedly connected with an upper base, and the upper base is fixedly provided with a telescopic pipe; when limiting the material loading volume, the base under manual promotion makes flexible pipe vertical removal to required position under the cooperation of scale, through locking screw action, fixes the guide bar to can adjust the material loading volume, satisfy the production demand of different specification cutting pieces, also realized the function of ration material loading simultaneously, make the cutting piece specification of producing unified, improved subsequent result of use.

title: Numerical control plate grooving equipment for custom-made cupboard processing
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of plate processing, in particular to numerical control plate grooving equipment for customized cabinet processing, which comprises a base, wherein a mounting plate is arranged above the base, a fixed shaft is fixedly connected to the middle part of one side of the mounting plate, a cutter head is rotatably connected to the fixed shaft, a plurality of mounting grooves are formed in the outer side wall of the cutter head, cutters are arranged in the mounting grooves, a driving assembly for driving the mounting plate to move is arranged at the top of the base, and clamping plates are symmetrically arranged at the two sides of the top of the base; according to the utility model, through the connection and fixation of the rotary cutter disc and the corresponding fixing holes by the cooperation of the fixing rods and the different cutters arranged on the rotary cutter disc, on one hand, the connection and fixation of the cutter disc with the rotary motor are realized, on the other hand, the rotation of the cutter disc is synchronously limited, the stability of the cutter disc during groove pulling is improved, and the quick replacement of the different cutters by the rotation of the cutter disc is realized through the separation of the fixing rods and the fixing holes.

title: Automatic stamping device with automatically, get work piece function
abstract: The utility model discloses an automatic stamping device with a function of automatically taking workpieces, which comprises a stamping component, a manipulator and a conveying component, wherein the conveying component is arranged on the side surface of the stamping component, the manipulator is arranged above the conveying component and can move into the stamping component to clamp the workpieces, the manipulator comprises a bracket fixed on the conveying component, a first slide rail fixed on the bracket and transversely arranged, and a second slide rail slidably connected on the first slide rail and transversely arranged, a third slide rail is vertically arranged on the second slide rail, a clamping jaw is fixed at the lower end of the third slide rail, the stamping component, the manipulator and the conveying component form the automatic stamping device, under the stamping of the stamping component, a slag ladle part and a workpiece part of the workpiece with a slag ladle are separated, and the workpiece is further moved to the conveying component through the clamping of the manipulator, the processing technology of automatically removing the slag ladle is completed, and the participation of manpower is reduced, the labor intensity of workers is reduced, the automation is improved, the production efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the safety is improved.

title: Communication method and apparatus
abstract: This application provides a communication method and apparatus. The method includes: A network device sends first configuration information to a terminal device, where the first configuration information is used to configure that the terminal device reports one or more pieces of feedback information, the feedback information is used to describe measurement information of N reference signals, each of the N reference signals corresponds to one resource, resources corresponding to the N reference signals belong to a same resource set, each piece of feedback information corresponds to one resource set, the feedback information includes N information groups, an n th information group in the N information groups includes a measurement result of an n th reference signal and/or an identifier of a resource corresponding to the n th reference signal, N is an integer greater than or equal to 1, and n∈[1, N].

title: Information Transmission Method, Network Device and Terminal Device
abstract: Implementations of the present disclosure provide an information transmission method, a network device and a terminal device. The method includes: a network device sends first configuration information to a terminal device through a first control channel, wherein the first control channel is a control channel in a resource for which a first numerology is used, the first configuration information is used for indicating configuration in a resource for which a second numerology is used, and the first numerology is different from the second numerology.

title: Communication method, apparatus and system
abstract: Embodiments of this application provide a communication method, apparatus, and system. In the method, when a first condition is met, a terminal device determines a target PUCCH resource, and sends an acknowledgment codebook to a network device on the target PUCCH resource. The first condition includes: A first PUCCH resource overlaps a second PUCCH resource, or a first PUCCH resource and a second PUCCH resource are in a same time unit. The first PUCCH resource carries first feedback information corresponding to first downlink data. The first feedback information includes first NACK information of the first downlink data but does not include first ACK information. The acknowledgment codebook includes third feedback information corresponding to the first downlink data and at least one piece of second feedback information. The third feedback information includes the first NACK information or the first ACK information. The terminal device sends an acknowledgment codebook including feedback information corresponding to the first downlink data and feedback information corresponding to the second downlink data, to effectively resolve conflict between feedback moments of feedback information corresponding to a plurality of pieces of downlink data.

title: Communication method and device
abstract: The embodiment of the application provides a communication method and a communication device. The network device sends first configuration information to the first terminal device, sends second configuration information to the second terminal device, the first configuration information and the second configuration information are used for the first terminal device and the second terminal device to execute relevant joint sending, the second terminal device sends first data to the first terminal device and processes the first data based on the second configuration information, the first terminal device receives the first data from the second terminal device and processes the first data based on the first configuration information. The scheme can enable the first terminal equipment and the second terminal equipment to carry out the same processing on the same data, and the same data is sent on the air interface, so that the first terminal equipment and the second terminal equipment execute related joint sending, and the effect of saving resource expenditure is achieved.

title: Communication device, control method, base station, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides communication equipment, a control method, a base station and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the communication equipment comprises a transmitting link, a receiving link, an antenna module, a coupling module, a correction frequency conversion module and a logic module, wherein the antenna module is respectively connected with the transmitting link and the receiving link, the coupling module is respectively connected with the transmitting link, the receiving link and the antenna module, the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the transmitting link and/or the receiving link, when the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the transmitting link, the correction frequency conversion module is controlled to work, the transmitting link can transmit a first correction signal of a second frequency point, the receiving link can receive the first correction signal and transmit the first correction signal to the logic module for correction of a radio frequency signal, and when the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the receiving link, the transmitting link can transmit the second correction signal of the first frequency point, and the correction frequency conversion module is controlled to work so that the receiving link can receive the second correction signal and transmit the second correction signal to the logic module for correction of the radio frequency signal.

title: Special device for solid-liquid separation of sewage
abstract: The utility model relates to a special device for solid-liquid separation of sewage, which belongs to the technical field of sewage treatment and comprises a precipitation barrel; the utility model has the beneficial effects that the inclined tube filler layer is used for slowing down the water flow in the equipment frame, so that the sedimentation of impurities in sewage is facilitated, the precipitated water is discharged through the water outlet pipe, the impurities in the sewage fall through the dust fall tank and fall to the bottom of the sedimentation tank in the sedimentation tank, the impurities can be accumulated at the bottom of the sedimentation tank, when the impurities are required to be cleaned, the baffle is driven by the output end of the cloth-in motor to rotate on the lower surface of the equipment plate, the baffle and the dust fall tank on the equipment plate are alternately arranged, the baffle is used for blocking the dust fall tank, the underwater drop on the equipment plate is prevented, the impurities and the sewage at the bottom end of the sedimentation tank are discharged through the discharge pipe by opening the valve, the manual cleaning is not required, the trouble and the labor are saved, the sedimentation tank can work normally in the cleaning process, and the sewage treatment efficiency is improved.

title: Waste gas purifying device of cleaning agent production line
abstract: The utility model discloses an exhaust gas purification device of a cleaning agent production line, which comprises a purification box and a box door arranged on the purification box, wherein a control panel and a handle rod are arranged on the outer wall of the box door, an exhaust fan is arranged at the top of the purification box, a water collecting box is arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the purification box, a spray head driven by a driving component is arranged in the purification box, a pump is fixed on the inner wall of the purification box, the water inlet end of the pump penetrates through the purification box, the pump is connected with the spray head through a water pipe, a stirring mechanism connected with the driving component is arranged in the purification box, a drain pipe is arranged on the outer wall of the water collecting box, the driving component comprises a threaded screw rod rotatably arranged in the purification box, and a bidirectional motor with an output shaft coaxially fixed with the threaded screw rod is fixed on the outer wall of the purification box. The utility model combines the sprayed water body and the mixed and stirred water body to perform better adsorption effect on the soluble smell in the cleaning agent.

title: Waste treatment device
