abstract: The utility model discloses a waste treatment device, which comprises a plurality of structures as follows: the device comprises a support frame, a collecting box, a filtering structure, a drying structure and a stirring processing structure, wherein the collecting box is divided into two areas by adopting a baffle with micropores, so that one-time simple filtering is realized, and solid-liquid separation is realized; the solid waste is collected and then subjected to harmless treatment in other forms, the liquid waste is subjected to subsequent treatment in the device, the liquid waste is subjected to harmless treatment by reacting with added components in the stirring treatment structure, solid is possibly separated out in the treatment process, then the solid is sucked into the filtering structure through the adsorption pump to be filtered, solid-liquid separation is realized, then the separated solid is dried, and finally the harmless treatment of the waste is realized.

title: But chemical waste gas treatment device of automatically cleaning
abstract: The utility model relates to a chemical waste gas treatment technical field specifically is a but chemical waste gas treatment device of automatically cleaning, including exhaust treatment device body, servo motor, first driving motor and second driving motor, the air inlet has been installed to the side of exhaust treatment device body, the motor case has been installed on the top of exhaust treatment device body, servo motor has been installed to the inside of motor case, and servo motor's output shaft fixed mounting has a common gear. The utility model discloses a be provided with second driving motor and suction pump, can spray water suction outlet pipe in the middle of through the suction pump, the rethread goes out the water shower nozzle, can carry out neutralization treatment with this internal chemical waste gas of exhaust treatment device through this mode, can make the carriage carry out the oscilaltion through servo motor's rotation, through carrying out the oscilaltion with the laminating of clearance scraper blade on the inner wall of exhaust treatment device body, can clear up the inner wall of exhaust treatment device body.

title: Air treatment device based on clean room system
abstract: The utility model relates to an air purification handles technical field, specifically is an air treatment device based on clean room system, include: the box body is internally provided with a filter plate, the right side wall of the box body is provided with a second mounting groove, the stop rod is connected with a telescopic spring and a fixed block, and the movable rod is connected with a return spring and a baffle; the beneficial effects are that: at first, press the clamp plate, make the movable rod drive reset spring and stretch, make the baffle extrude the fixed block, thereby make fixed block extrusion expanding spring shrink, the one end that has the fillet with the fixed block separates with mounting groove two and shrinks mounting groove one, elastic action through sealing rubber pad on the pin lateral wall is popped out the pin from the square hole slowly afterwards, at last pulling filter, and through the slip between slider and the spout, so that dismantle the filter from the box inside fast.

title: Heat dissipation valve plate seat
abstract: The utility model discloses a radiating valve plate seat, which comprises a body; the body comprises a bottom plate and a barrel body integrally and upwards extending from the surface of the bottom plate, a water inlet hole and a water outlet hole are formed in the bottom plate, the barrel body is provided with a containing cavity with an upward opening and communicated with the water inlet hole and the water outlet hole, and a plurality of radiating fins are integrally and outwards extending from the outer side wall of the barrel body. Through the integrative barrel that upwards extends on the bottom plate surface to an organic whole outwards extends on the lateral wall of cooperation barrel and has a plurality of heat radiation fins, makes the heat that the valve plate seat produced in the course of the work in time discharge through integrated into one piece's heat radiation fins, avoids the valve plate seat inside to make the sealing member receive the damage or even become invalid because of the thermal-arrest, does not need often to change the sealing member, has not only effectively improved the life of air compressor machine, has still reduced the use cost of air compressor machine.

title: Electrical equipment protection device convenient to heat dissipation
abstract: The utility model provides an electrical equipment protection device convenient for heat dissipation, which comprises a box body and a second fan, wherein the upper end of the box body is fixedly connected with a rain shelter, the second fan is arranged at the upper end in the box body, window holes are arranged at the left and right ends of the box body, a first clamping groove is arranged at the upper end of the window hole, a second clamping groove is arranged at the lower end of the window hole, a spring is fixedly connected with the upper end of the second clamping groove, a ventilation mechanism is clamped in the first clamping groove and the second clamping groove, the spring is movably connected with the ventilation mechanism, a bottom plate is fixedly connected with the lower end of the box body, a first filter screen is fixedly connected with the lower end of the bottom plate, and a fan hole is; through setting up heat dissipation mechanism, can make outside air inhale inside the box when the inside temperature of box risees, through the rotation of first fan with the second fan, the inside high-temperature gas that produces by electrical equipment of box passes through heat dissipation mechanism, flows from the air outlet, reaches the radiating effect.

title: Copper wire production heat treatment device
abstract: The utility model provides a copper wire production heat treatment device, which comprises a box body, wherein the box body is internally provided with the following components in sequence from a wire inlet to a wire outlet: first cavity, second cavity, third cavity are equipped with electric heating pipe in the first cavity, and the inner wall laminating of second cavity has the heat preservation cotton, has set gradually from top to bottom in the third cavity: the cooling device comprises an upper cavity, a middle cavity provided with a heat dissipation hole, and a lower cavity provided with an infusion pump, wherein the upper cavity is filled with a cooling liquid with a preset volume, an electric two-way valve communicated with the upper cavity is fixedly arranged in the middle cavity, a first valve of the electric two-way valve is communicated with a cooling pipe which is arranged in a winding way, a second valve of the electric two-way valve is communicated with the infusion pipe, the cooling pipe is communicated with the other end of the cooling pipe and the lower cavity, and the infusion pipe is communicated with the cooling pipe. This practicality provides copper wire production heat treatment device, can carry out the cold circulation to the coolant liquid in the upper chamber and trade, need not to consume a large amount of coolant liquid, and not only the cooling effect is good, and with low costs.

title: Device suitable for tail gas heat transfer cooling
abstract: The utility model discloses a device suitable for heat exchange and cooling of tail gas, which comprises a treatment box, wherein one end of the treatment box is provided with an air inlet, a plurality of baffles are arranged in the treatment box, so that a curved airflow channel is formed in the treatment box, a radiating fin tube is arranged in the airflow channel, a water storage room is arranged at the bottom of the treatment box, one side of the treatment box is provided with an air outlet channel, a packing layer is arranged in the air outlet channel, a spraying mechanism is arranged above the packing layer, a fan is connected above the air outlet channel, and the fan is connected with an air outlet. The utility model has reasonable structural design, the baffle plate is arranged in the treatment box to form a curved airflow channel, so that the hot airflow and the radiating fin tube can be fully contacted, the cooling effect is far superior to that of common dust removing equipment, and the dust removal and the cooling effect are good by adopting a plurality of groups of filler layers.

title: Heat exchange module, heat management device and vehicle
abstract: The utility model discloses a heat exchange module, a heat management device and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of vehicle heat management, wherein the heat exchange module is applied to the vehicle and comprises a flow passage plate, a liquid storage dryer, a heat exchanger and a throttling element, wherein a refrigerant flow passage is arranged in the flow passage plate, connecting ports communicated with the refrigerant flow passage are arranged on two opposite sides of the flow passage plate in the thickness direction, the liquid storage dryer, the heat exchanger and the throttling element are arranged on two sides of the flow passage plate in the thickness direction, and the liquid storage dryer, the heat exchanger and the throttling element are communicated with the connecting ports and are used for forming a refrigerant loop with a compressor. According to the technical scheme provided by the utility model, the liquid storage dryer, the heat exchanger and the throttling element are arranged on the two sides of the flow passage plate along the thickness direction, so that the compactness of the heat exchange module is improved, and the arrangement space of the front engine room is saved.

title: Electronic Gaming Machine and Method with Transformable Grid Pick Selections and Multi-State Reveal Mechanics
abstract: A gaming machine comprising a plurality of grid positions, and a game controller to at least: randomly populate a plurality of grid positions with one of a plurality of grid symbols, receive one or more selections of the plurality of grid positions, resulting a plurality of unselected grid positions, reveal a plurality of unrevealed symbols at each of the plurality of grid positions selected, in response to a first grid position selected revealing the first symbol, repopulate the first grid position with one of a plurality of chance symbols including the first symbol and the second symbol, and in response to the first grid position selected revealing the second symbol, determine a first award based on the second symbol.

title: Household appliance control method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a household appliance control method and device. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: at least two microprocessors in the household appliance are combined into one physical microprocessor; creating two boxes and an internal channel between the two boxes for the merged physical microprocessor, wherein one box is a control box for performing local closed-loop control of the home appliance, the other box is a network box for performing communication control based on communication with the outside of the home appliance, and the internal channel is used for performing communication between the two boxes; the control of the home appliance is performed according to the two boxes created. The invention solves the technical problem of low control efficiency caused by unreasonable MCU setting in household appliance control in the related art.

title: Laminated separator for non-aqueous electrolytic solution secondary battery
abstract: To provide a laminated separator for a non-aqueous electrolytic solution secondary battery that can alleviate an increase in AC resistance after compression.SOLUTION: A laminated separator for a non-aqueous electrolytic solution secondary battery according to an embodiment of the present invention has a functional layer for a non-aqueous electrolytic solution secondary battery laminated on a polyolefin substrate. After application of pressure at 20 MPa to the laminated separator for a non-aqueous electrolytic solution secondary battery, the compressibility of the functional layer for a non-aqueous electrolytic solution secondary battery is 15% or more, and the compressibility of the polyolefin substrate is 5% or less.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title: Novel citizen card reader
abstract: The utility model discloses a novel citizen card reader which comprises a mounting bracket, wherein a card reader is arranged on one side of the mounting bracket, a card reading area is arranged on the outer wall of the card reader, and an identity card reading area is arranged at the lower end of the card reading area; this novel citizen's card reader through the cooperation use between heat radiating panel and the radiator fin, can derive through heat radiating panel the heat that the card reader is inside to produce under the circumstances of card reader long-time work, then cooperate radiator fin to dispel the heat of heat radiating panel derivation, prevent to use inside temperature for a long time to cause inside electronic component to damage easily, and cause the influence to follow-up card reading effect, the setting of shield can be fine plays dirt-proof effect to the card reader, protect the card slot of punching the card reader under the circumstances that the card reader does not use, prevent to brush the inside attached dust of card slot, cause the influence to the flexibility of punching the card.

title: Information processing device and program
abstract: In the present invention, a display control unit 33: displays a stop button 41 for temporarily stopping a process in progress, the stop button being displayed on an operation screen in an operation panel 42 even when a job in progress that can be stopped does not exist; and if, when the stop button 41 is pressed, a job to be temporarily stopped does not exist, displays a list of completed jobs. If, when the stop button 41 is pressed, a job to be stopped exists, the display control unit 33 temporarily stops the job in progress and displays a list of temporarily stopped jobs that were in progress and jobs awaiting execution.
